openings.claim: Extra downward corner compression may be unnecessary: removable edge bearing replaces added seal-friction retention. Neither retention implies tight compression nor tight compression implies retention. Four strips form two bolted, rubber-protected rim clips with keepers beside/above opposite hatch edges; adjust clearance without forcing the left corner down, slide clips completely clear for opening, tether recoverable components.
openings.discriminator: Same-clip rival attributes retention mainly to downward-preload seal friction. Edge bearing predicts at most 1 mm displacement under 20 N with light preload and no induced opposite-corner lift; friction predicts deterioration when extra preload is removed. Predictions are prospective.
openings.probe: Check capture geometry before fabrication; ninety minutes fabrication, twenty minutes observation. Source schedules two ordinary tightened closures plus one right-contact-card closure, then ten removal-arm opening cycles with final closure disturbed. Enumerated 3+10 conflicts with twelve total closure/pull trials; unresolved. Maximum two configurations, each disturbed. Measure marked displacement, 20 N pull, single-technician reopening time, tears each cycle and corner lift. Reject any candidate cycle above 1 mm or thirty seconds, any new tear, obstructed open inspection area or failed disturbed closure. Retain existing hatch/rim/seal; no hatch/trough drilling, cutting, glue or permanent deformation, no powered mechanism; drill only supplied strips. Stop before damage if tightening threatens constraints; incomplete probing establishes no outcome.
openings.uncertainty: Unspecified rim underside access, hatch-edge clearance and keeper-removal paths can defeat construction. Protective pad/strip contact requires inspection. Clip grip and strip stiffness must transmit 20 N without slip/excessive bending; dimensions establish no capacity.

lineage.reason: Causal relation, reciprocal implication challenge, rival, defeat conditions, resource/stopping caveats, uncertainties and declared uncertain fit retained; trial-allocation conflict explicit.

decision: Resolve geometry, capacity, protection and trial allocation before claiming success. No feasible counterexample or deployment demonstrated; avoiding extra compression alone does not establish seal stability.
